verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.canva.com) exposing design generation, editing, discovery, export, and comment tools via natural language to AI assistants, and this was confirmed live in a runtime probe (proper OAuth challenge response, not a dead endpoint). Docs explicitly describe this as giving users access to Canva's design capabilities 'through natural language, directly from the AI tools they already use.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on end-to-end usage report showing a full natural-language command actually completing a design task (only the auth handshake was probed, not full tool invocation).
